chunks: Al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Jawharī narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, who said:

"There is no divorce except according to the sunnah (prophetic tradition). Indeed, ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar pronounced divorce three times in one sitting while his wife was menstruating, so the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم rejected his divorce and said:"
"Whatever contradicts the Book of Allah must be referred back to the Book of Allah."

key_terms.كِتَابَ ٱللَّهِ: the Book of Allah, the Qur'an as the ultimate legal criterion
key_terms.ٱلسُّنَّةِ: the prescribed prophetic manner and legally valid procedure
key_terms.ٱلطَّلَاقَ: divorce, the legal dissolution of marriage

ai.seo_question: Is a divorce valid if it is pronounced three times in one sitting or during menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that divorce is valid only when carried out in accordance with the sunnah (prophetic tradition). It cites the case of ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar, whose divorce was rejected because it was issued in a manner contrary to divine law, establishing that anything opposing the Book of Allah must be returned to it for judgment.
